title: Turnip Swede Puree
preamble:
Ingredients:-
About
1 lb of turnips, peeled and cut into large chunks
About
1 lb of swede, peeled and cut into large chunks
1-2
cloves of garlic, chopped finely
25-50g
butter
Salt
and pepper

About
1 lb of turnips, peeled and cut into large chunks
About
1 lb of swede, peeled and cut into large chunks
1-2
cloves of garlic, chopped finely
25-50g
butter
Salt
and pepper

Method:-
Boil the turnips and swede in lightly salted water.
Drain the water into a bowl.
Fry the garlic in butter
Place everything in a food processor and blast to a purée. If necessary add a little of the reserved water to make a smooth purée.
Taste and add salt and pepper and more butter as needed.
